name: stat-block
title: StatBlock
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A label, a big tight figure and one line of meaning. Use whenever a number is the point of a section.

hairline.purpose: Presents a figure with its consequence.
dontUseWhen: a figure inside a table row
hairline.example: <StatBlock label="Total expenses" value="1 284 900" unit="XAF" note="258 900 of it is the deferred fees." />
hairline.antiExampleWhy: No label, no consequence, and a sans figure with comma grouping instead of the system's mono tabular figures.

docs: Say the number, then say what it means: a `value` without a `note` is usually a missed sentence.
